name: Wampus Cat
description: A panther-like cryptid of Appalachian folklore with roots in Cherokee mythology, often described as a large, dark cat — sometimes with extra legs, glowing eyes, and shapeshifting powers — said to roam the southeastern United States.

aliases.name: Catawampus
aliases.meaning: regional adjective sometimes used for the creature

origin: Reports and folklore concentrate in the southern Appalachian Mountains (Tennessee, North Carolina, Kentucky, West Virginia, Virginia, northern Georgia and Alabama) and the Ozarks (Arkansas, Missouri).
